listing.summary: Experimental project. Upstream native boot/main 3D and secondary 2D programs translated ahead of time; steady 60 FPS Linux busy mazes claimed. No Portcove playthrough or Deck qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA SLUS01018 own disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual own CUE with seven BINs to disc/: build_emitters.sh, psxrecomp_cli generate, CMake psx-runtime then launch-mspacman.sh. Switch build is same implementation and outside this followup.
